title: Princeton will survive the AI era by going back to its purpose
snippet: Princeton has begun mandating proctors in exam halls to combat AI cheating, but securing assessments does not protect trust in learning. The university should separate AI literacy from tools that offload thinking and establish a two-way AI honor code where faculty pledge not to use AI for surveillance.
match_reason: websearch (op_ed) — This op-ed from a peer R1 university offers a precedent-setting perspective on academic integrity, honor codes, and student-faculty trust in the AI era.

title: What should AI governance in education actually cover?
snippet: Two international Delphi studies on AI governance in education outline an eight-part framework for higher education. The findings emphasize that universities must go beyond plagiarism and cheating to address integration strategy, institutional support, and infrastructure.
match_reason: websearch (blog_post) — This global study provides a comprehensive, peer-reviewed framework for higher education AI governance, directly informing system-wide policy decisions for institutions like UC.

title: Emory, adopt a comprehensive AI policy
snippet: Emory University's lack of a unified AI policy leaves students confused and fails to prepare them to responsibly use the tool in the professional world. Standardized, centralized policies are needed to view AI as a tool students must learn to use responsibly rather than leaving it to individual professors.
match_reason: websearch (op_ed) — This op-ed highlights the growing student demand at peer research universities for centralized, standardized AI policies that balance academic integrity with career readiness.

title: These teachers fight AI cheating with classes that force students to show they are learning
snippet: College professors are throwing out old assignments and moving away from unreliable AI detectors. Instead, they are implementing process-based assessments—such as handwritten outlines, video reflections, and chatbot transcripts—to ensure students are actually learning in the ChatGPT era.
match_reason: websearch (news_article) — This national news coverage highlights a major sector-wide shift in academic integrity and assessment strategies that peer institutions, including the UC system, are actively weighing.

title: NSF Awards $20M to USC and Collaborators to Renew AI Institute
snippet: The National Science Foundation renewed the Artificial Intelligence Institute for Advances in Optimization (AI4OPT) with a $20 million grant through 2031. Led by Georgia Tech, the institute's key partners include USC and UC Berkeley, with USC's share doubling to $5.6 million.
match_reason: websearch (press_release) — This major federal renewal directly impacts AI research and education at UC Berkeley and USC, supporting interdisciplinary research and graduate training in AI and optimization.

title: Strengthening America's AI Ecosystem with the Launch of the NSF NAIRR Operations Center
snippet: The National Science Foundation awarded a $35 million cooperative agreement over five years to the San Diego Supercomputer Center (SDSC) at UC San Diego to establish and run the NSF National AI Research Resource (NAIRR) Operations Center, in collaboration with UT Austin.
match_reason: websearch (press_release) — This major federal award establishes UC San Diego as the operational lead for the National AI Research Resource, directly impacting AI research infrastructure and access for students and researchers nationwide.
